scope: Startup/runtime audit; in-memory ELF input for existing libtcc relocation; private address-index and directory-only experiments rejected

startup.scope: Five interleaved fresh processes after one warmup per variant/workload; precise GC and identical preexisting authored artifacts/images; diagnostic native overlay only. Background user workloads active.

json.scope: Independent warmed phases with prepared inputs retained; not additive attribution. Timing mode retains normal GC. Allocation mode disables automatic GC for one measured pass; its time is not the timing baseline.

logue.scope: Script loader path; startup/source loading, fixture setup, GC between batches, snapshots and JSON are outside phase timers. Timing keeps normal GC and Store history. Allocation mode disables automatic GC for one batch and is not a timing baseline. Live counters are process-wide and include retained harness output; charge is GC accounting, not RSS.

rejected_experiments.disposition: Private address-index changes gave no reliable end-to-end improvement and were reverted. Directory-only staging reduction was superseded by the memory loader.

import os,subprocess,time,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
work=Path('/tmp/birnam-runtime-audit-20261019'); script=work/'ready.birnam';script.write_text('[System println: "ready"]\n')
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('BIRNAM_')};env['BIRNAM_GC_PRECISE']='1'
prefixes={'before':'/tmp/birnam-image-simplification/prefix','current':'/tmp/birnam-candidate-policy/compact-prefix'}
rows=[]
for name,prefix in prefixes.items():
 for phase,delay,duration in [('early',0.05,3),('late',2.4,2)]:
  p=subprocess.Popen([prefix+'/bin/birnam',str(script)],env=env,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
  time.sleep(delay);path=work/(name+'-'+phase+'.sample.txt')
  sampled=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/sample',str(p.pid),str(duration),'1','-file',str(path)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
  out,err=p.communicate(timeout=30)
  assert p.returncode==0 and out==b'ready\n' and not err,(name,out,err)
  assert path.exists() and path.stat().st_size,(sampled.returncode,sampled.stderr)
  rows.append({'variant':name,'phase':phase,'delay_seconds':delay,'duration_seconds':duration,'sample_status':sampled.returncode,'path':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
  print(name,phase,'sampled',flush=True)
(work/'startup-samples.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

import os,subprocess,selectors,json,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
from validation_support import clean_environment
import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('logue_bench',Path.cwd()/'scripts/logue-bench.py');logue=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(logue)
w=Path('/tmp/birnam-runtime-audit-20261019');binary='/tmp/birnam-candidate-policy/compact-prefix/bin/birnam';env=clean_environment()
def profile(label,args,cwd,skip=()):
 p=subprocess.Popen(args,cwd=cwd,env=env,stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 poll=selectors.DefaultSelector();poll.register(p.stdout,selectors.EVENT_READ)
 start=time.monotonic()
 while True:
  if not poll.select(120-(time.monotonic()-start)):raise TimeoutError(label+' readiness')
  line=p.stdout.readline().strip()
  if line=='ready':break
  assert line in skip,(label,line,p.poll())
 poll.close();dest=w/(label+'.sample.txt')
 sample=subprocess.Popen(['/usr/bin/sample',str(p.pid),'5','1','-file',str(dest)],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
 p.stdin.write('go\n');p.stdin.flush();out,err=p.communicate(timeout=120)
 _,samperr=sample.communicate(timeout=15)
 assert p.returncode==0 and not err,(label,p.returncode,err)
 assert sample.returncode==0 and dest.exists(),(label,samperr)
 result=json.loads(out);(w/(label+'.result.json')).write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(label,'sample completed',flush=True);return result
project=w/'log-summary/examples/log-summary/profile';fixture=w/'log-summary/data/small.jsonl'
x=profile('json-full',[binary,'run',str(project),'--',str(fixture),'full','24','sample'],w/'log-summary')
expected=json.loads((w/'log-summary/data/small.expected.json').read_text());assert x['report']==expected and json.loads(x['rendered'])==expected
project=w/'logue/logue';src=(project/'logue-bench.birnam').read_text();assert 'let results :=' in src
(project/'profile-harness.birnam').write_text(src.replace('let results :=','[System println: "ready"]; [System readLine];\nlet results :=',1))
config=dict(phase='arena',seed=12345,width=16,monsters=8,turns=128,batches=1,samples=1,allocation=False,replace=False)
(project/'profile.birnam').write_text('[Globals at: #LogueBenchConfig put: '+logue.literal(config)+'];\n[System load: "profile-harness.birnam"]\n')
x=profile('logue-crowded',[binary,'profile.birnam'],project,skip=('[logue-core] loaded',));logue.check_report(x,config)
print('Both sampled results passed independent oracles',flush=True)

compare.py.source:
import os,time,resource,json,statistics,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'scripts'))
from validation_support import clean_environment
root=Path.cwd();w=Path('/tmp/birnam-runtime-audit-20261019');base=Path('/tmp/birnam-candidate-policy/compact-prefix')
variants={'baseline':base,'indexes':w/'prefix-indexes','object-loading':w/'prefix-object-loading','combined':w/'prefix-combined'}
env=clean_environment();env['BIRNAM_GC_PRECISE']='1'
def run(prefix,script):
 before=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN);start=time.perf_counter();p=subprocess.run([str(prefix/'bin/birnam'),str(script)],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=90);wall=time.perf_counter()-start;after=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
 assert p.returncode==0 and not p.stderr,(p.returncode,p.stderr,p.stdout)
 return dict(wall_seconds=wall,cpu_seconds=after.ru_utime+after.ru_stime-before.ru_utime-before.ru_stime,stdout=p.stdout)
rows=[]
for name,prefix in variants.items():assert run(prefix,w/'ready.birnam')['stdout']=='ready\n'
for i in range(4):
 names=list(variants);names=names[i:]+names[:i]
 for name in names:
  result=run(variants[name],w/'ready.birnam');assert result.pop('stdout')=='ready\n';rows.append(dict(variant=name,repeat=i,**result))
 (w/'startup-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
 print('startup round',i+1,flush=True)
medians={n:{k:statistics.median(r[k] for r in rows if r['variant']==n) for k in ['wall_seconds','cpu_seconds']} for n in variants}
(w/'startup-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'medians':medians},indent=2)+'\n');print('STARTUP',medians,flush=True)
# Timed region excludes startup and source loading; exact result and liveness checks.
gc=w/'gc.birnam';gc.write_text('''[Module load: #time];
let keeper := [Cell with: "alive"];
[System gc];
let results := [[1 to: 5] collect: [:i |
 let start := [16 clockNanos]; [5 timesRepeat: [| [System gc]]]; [[16 clockNanos] - start]
]];
[System println: results]; [System println: [keeper value]]
''')
rows=[]
for i,name in enumerate(['baseline','combined','combined','baseline']):
 r=run(variants[name],gc);assert r['stdout'].splitlines()[-1]=='alive',r
 import re
 r['batch_cpu_ns']=list(map(int,re.findall(r'\d+',r['stdout'].splitlines()[0])));assert len(r['batch_cpu_ns'])==5,r
 rows.append(dict(variant=name,repeat=i,**r));print('GC',name,r['batch_cpu_ns'],flush=True)
(w/'gc-comparison.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'median_batch_cpu_ns':{n:statistics.median(t for r in rows if r['variant']==n for t in r['batch_cpu_ns']) for n in ['baseline','combined']}},indent=2)+'\n')
# ABBA application comparisons use their existing independent oracles.
for i,name in enumerate(['baseline','combined','combined','baseline']):
 prefix=variants[name]
 for app,args in [('json',['scripts/log-summary-profile.py','--prefix',str(prefix),'--work',str(w/f'pair-json-{i}-{name}'),'--iterations','3']),('logue',['scripts/logue-bench.py','--prefix',str(prefix),'--work',str(w/f'pair-logue-{i}-{name}'),'--cases','quiet,crowded,generation','--samples','2','--skip-regression'])]:
  with (w/f'pair-{app}-{i}-{name}.log').open('w') as log:subprocess.run([sys.executable,*args],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True,timeout=450)
  print('application',i,name,app,'passed',flush=True)
print('COMPARISONS COMPLETE',flush=True)

import subprocess,json,os
from pathlib import Path
w=Path('/tmp/birnam-runtime-audit-20261019');base=Path('/tmp/birnam-candidate-policy/compact-prefix');new=w/'prefix-memory';image=w/'no-temp.image';source=w/'save-no-temp.birnam'
source.write_text('[Globals at: #main put: [| [System println: "ready"]]]; [System saveImage: '+json.dumps(str(image))+']\n')
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('BIRNAM_','DYLD_'))};env['BIRNAM_GC_PRECISE']='1'
p=subprocess.run([base/'bin/birnam',source],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180);assert p.returncode==0 and not p.stderr and image.is_file(),p
print('Existing-format image saved by baseline',flush=True)
env['TMPDIR']=str(w/'nonexistent-temp-directory')
assert not Path(env['TMPDIR']).exists()
rows=[]
for name,prefix in [('baseline',base),('memory',new)]:
 p=subprocess.run([prefix/'bin/birnam',image],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120)
 rows.append({'variant':name,'exit_code':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr})
 print(name,p.returncode,p.stdout.strip(),p.stderr[:250],flush=True)
assert rows[0]['exit_code']!=0 and rows[1]['exit_code']==0 and rows[1]['stdout']=='ready\n' and not rows[1]['stderr']
assert not Path(env['TMPDIR']).exists()
(w/'no-temp-image.json').write_text(json.dumps({'rows':rows,'image':str(image),'source':source.read_text(),'temporary_directory':env['TMPDIR']},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Image load requires no object staging files',flush=True)

limits: macOS arm64, local warm-cache measurements, background user workloads active.
Diagnostic timing uses identical existing authored artifacts/images; changed native binaries exactly match final fresh-prefix build.
Representative CPU applications, not exhaustive performance coverage of every language API.
JSON sample includes explicit GC between passes; Logue sample includes one final arena reset/GC before its turn batch. Phase timers exclude these setup costs.
Trusted relocatable ELF objects are the memory API input. This does not turn libtcc into a sandbox for untrusted native code.
Compilation output and system-library resolution still use libtcc existing APIs. Only loading object bytes is free of temporary staging.
No user-prefix installation, push, or release qualification.
